hnwsg.title: 宋希濂將軍的抗日壯舉
hnwsg.publisher: 湖南省文史研究館《湖湘文史》2017年第1期
hnwsg.gradeBasis: 政府文史研究機構刊物、具名作者

body.zh-Hant: 宋希濂為湖南湘鄉人，黃埔軍校第一期畢業，1930年5月畢業於日本步兵學校和參謀學院。1931年冬升任第一教導師二旅旅長，該師改編後，他為該師二六一旅旅長，率部駐紮南京，後因戰功卓著晉升為八十七師副師長兼第二旅旅長。
body.en: Song Xilian was a native of Xiangxiang, Hunan, and a graduate of the first class of Whampoa. He graduated from the Japanese Infantry School and Staff College in May 1930. In winter 1931 he became commander of the 2nd Brigade of the 1st Training Division; after the division was reorganized he commanded its 261st Brigade, stationed at Nanjing, and was later promoted deputy commander of the 87th Division for his battlefield merit.

citations.quote: 宋希濂（1907—1997），字荫国，湖南省湘乡县人。黄埔军校一期毕业。
citations.evidenceNote: 籍貫與黃埔一期；文中生年1997卒年與他說不一，本段不採

citations.evidenceNote: 改編後任261旅旅長，駐南京

body.zh-Hant: 1936年12月西安事變爆發時，宋希濂是駐紮蘇州的國民黨三十六師師長，奉命率部入陝。8月13日日軍調集重兵進攻上海，他立即率三十六師日夜兼程，於16日趕到上海前線。其後三十六師被軍委會改為七十八軍，宋任軍長，但他實際管轄的部隊仍然是一個師。
body.en: When the Xi'an Incident broke out in December 1936, Song was commander of the 36th Division, then stationed at Suzhou, and was ordered into Shaanxi. When Japan massed troops against Shanghai on 13 August, he rushed the 36th Division there and reached the front on the 16th. The division was later redesignated the 78th Army with Song as army commander, though he still actually controlled only one division.

citations.evidenceNote: 上下文為1937年（前文「1937年7月7日，日军发动卢沟桥事变」）

citations.locator: 劉秉勳〈宋希濂將軍的抗日壯舉〉全文

citations.evidenceNote: 承上句8月；16日抵上海前線

citations.evidenceNote: 文中置於淞滬會戰持續到9月份之處，未給78軍任命確切日期

body.zh-Hant: 宋希濂率領的三十六師在淞滬會戰中與日軍血戰近3個月，其後他奉命率三十六師在會戰中剩下的3000兵力參加南京保衛戰。蔣介石又重新召回宋希濂，任命為榮譽一師師長，5月升任七十一軍軍長。
body.en: Song's 36th Division fought the Japanese for nearly three months at Shanghai; he was then ordered to lead its remaining 3,000 men in the defence of Nanjing. Chiang Kai-shek later recalled him, appointed him commander of the Honor 1st Division, and in May promoted him commander of the 71st Army.
